title: Harness python-edit-guard: no python source patching
desc: Blocks python-based file writes (open w, writelines, shutil) to source, which risk silent encoding/CRLF corruption. Use the Edit/Write tool, wkedit, or delegate.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when a Bash/PowerShell command uses python to write a source file (open(...,'w'), .write, writelines, shutil.copy onto source).
FIX: use the Edit/Write tool for surgical edits, wkedit for atomic UTF-8-safe multi-file edits, or Agent.cmd --model haiku for the mechanical change. Temp-file writes outside the repo are fine.
WHY: python writes can silently re-encode (CP949/CRLF) and bypass harness review; wkedit preserves encoding and makes a .bak. See: wkedit, file-command-cheatsheet.
author: claude
